523.name: bounding_boxes
523.docs:
Returns the range's transformed bounding boxes relative to the tree's
container (e.g. window).

If the return value is empty, it means that the source tree doesn't
provide enough information to calculate bounding boxes. Otherwise,
there will always be at least one box, even if it's zero-width,
as it is for a degenerate range.

19.name: subtree_root
19.docs: Returns the root NodeId of the subtree with the given TreeId, if it exists.

205.name: bounding_box
205.docs:
Returns the node's transformed bounding box relative to the tree's
container (e.g. window).

178.name: is_graft
178.docs: Returns true if this node is a graft node (has a tree_id property set).

201.name: transform
201.docs:
Returns the combined affine transform of this node and its ancestors,
up to and including the root of this node's tree.

199.name: direct_transform
199.docs:
Returns the transform defined directly on this node, or the identity
transform, without taking into account transforms on ancestors.

335.name: text_position_at_point
335.docs:
Returns the nearest text position to the given point
in this node's coordinate space.

56.name: into
56.docs: Calls `U::from(self)`. That is, this conversion is whatever the implementation of [From]<T> for U chooses to do.

206.name: node_at_point
206.docs:
Returns the deepest filtered node, either this node or a descendant,
at the given point in this node's coordinate space.
